protocol.rule: Using each fiber expert's own raw mask and probability, nominate the largest entry-near connected component under the preceding frozen FOV/size/geometry acceptance checks. If accepted, preserve its entire original mask and remove only other disconnected fiber components. Never intersect the retained component with the fitted tube or cap; never add fiber pixels. If no supported candidate, return the full raw mask. No temporal smoothing or parameter sweep
protocol.important_limits: Detached true distal pieces may be removed, so paired TP loss and occlusion failures must be reported. Geometry acceptance is not proof of true fiber. The1network arm reuses old190 for both classes and cannot recover stones missing from old190

geometry_config.model: Two robust straight shaft boundaries with positive smoothly varying width and an image-supported half-ellipse terminal cap. Not a physical3D cone; line intersection is never a tip. Entrance refers to estimated FOV boundary, not a fixed left edge

tracking.invalid_measurement_policy: Predict geometry at most3frames with increasing age; return raw current-frame visible mask, never rasterize a history-only hypothesis as visible fiber; then clear state

geometry_config.fusion: For accepted current-frame geometry, keep template-supported fiber pixels only where current A0 p(fiber)>=0.35 or raw A0 fiber is present. Else retain raw fiber. Recombine each output with unchanged old190 stone, fiber priority. Count removed/added fiber and overwritten/restored stone. A geometric hypothesis is exported separately; no amodal filled mask
